name: Platform Kanban Board
description: 3-column kanban board (Por hacer, En progreso, En revisión) with collapsible Completados checklist. HTML5 drag & drop between columns, checkmark to complete, card detail modal with comments and history timeline. Cards are labeled and filterable by their proposal scope item (vista/componente/funcionalidad) with an 'Sin agrupar' bucket. Admin has full control; client can only approve in_review cards.
